driver.scope: Synthetic headless benchmark, native AI and native debug battle lifecycle. Not earned campaign play.

attempts.narrative: T1 a 2x Thunderbolt removed Clauncher before it acted - the third consecutive pass in which the 'immediate pulse cannon' never fires - while Magearna's Thunderbolt took Frillish from 76 to 18; Frillish answered with Hex. Shellder came in. T2 Thunderbolt broke Shellder's Focus Sash and paralysed it, the second Thunderbolt removed Frillish, and Shellder was fully paralysed. Corphish came in. T3 Corphish's Choice Band Adaptability Aqua Jet removed Jolteon with priority - the only real hit Elliot landed - and Magearna finished Shellder, which never acted. T4 Kartana came in and Leaf Blade (2x) removed Corphish. Won 4-1.

ai_weak_choices.board: Frillish at full HP with Hex, Icy Wind, Will-O-Wisp and Recover, opposite an unstatused Magearna and an unstatused Jolteon.
ai_weak_choices.better: Will-O-Wisp (which is the setup Hex exists for) or Icy Wind for the speed control its partner needed. Hex at half power into a full-HP Steel/Fairy body was the lowest-value option it had.
ai_weak_choices.severity: weak choice. The AI does not appear to sequence its own status-then-payoff pair.

ai_improvements_observed: The Choice Band priority revenge kill on Jolteon was correctly identified and correctly timed.
No voluntary switches, no illegal or nonsensical targeting.
level_change_reason: Won on attempt 1 with a single player faint, in four turns, with Magearna finishing untouched at 80/80. That is the brief's 0-1 faint band: +1 on the weakest one or two members. Clauncher and Corphish are both at the +-2 ceiling and cannot move, so the points go to the two members with untouched budget - which are also the two that contributed least: Frillish spent its only turn on a 9 damage Hex, and Shellder has now never selected a move in any pass. Budget after this pass: CLAUNCHER +2 (exhausted), FRILLISH +1 of 2, SHELLDER +1 of 2, CORPHISH +2 (exhausted).
honest_assessment: Recording this plainly: I do not expect +1 to change the result. Every member of this team is a Water type and three of the four are removed by a single Electric attack from a cap-20 special attacker regardless of level. The only member that did anything is the one that ignored the type chart by using priority. The fix is in the cooler note, not in the level column.
cooler: Yes, and it is the same shape as Ned's. A four-member mono-Water roster at cap 20 loses to one Electric or Grass lead before its authored engines (Mega Launcher pulses, Shell Smash, Hex-after-burn) can start. Elliot does not need different species - he needs one member that survives the opening trade: a Rindo/Shuca-class berry or an Assault Vest on Clauncher, or moving the Focus Sash from Shellder (which was paralysed through it) to the pulse cannon that is supposed to fire on turn one. Recording only - no set change in this pass.
